liveAggregate.method: ABBA, one cloned level-1 role, 1500 steady captures per run after dropping the predefined first 300-capture warmup window; all remaining windows retained
limits: Paused workbench wait, no equipped skills/drugs and no Buff icons; not combat FPS or a weak-machine qualification.
Candidate run 1 includes late windows at 4.32 and 5.9767 ms; cause was not established and neither window was excluded.

One candidate window has four periodic full packets, the other windows have five. The unchanged getTimer()-lastFull>2000 gate is time-based, so sample-window phase does not force identical packet counts.
Both SWFs reproduce the equipment snapshot timeout. Boot/clone/HUD execution is verified, equipment-workbench E2E is not.
